name: Default
shortDescription: Steam trading card farming bot for multiple accounts, managed through the built-in ASF-ui web interface and IPC API.

alerts.message: ASF-ui asks for the IPC password on first visit: use the generated ASF_IPC_PASSWORD value. ASF runs headless, so a bot that needs a Steam Guard or 2FA code stops; send the code with the input command in the ASF-ui console (for example input MyBot SteamGuard ABCDE), then start the bot.
